# Toy 101 L1 — Questions

Answers in [[Toy 101 L1 Answers]].

1. Find $\bar{k}$ when $s = 0.3$, $A = 1$, $\alpha = 0.5$ and $\delta = 0.1$.
2. Does saving more raise long-run growth?

> [!check]- What is $\bar{k}$ when $s = 0.3$, $A = 1$, $\alpha = 0.5$, $\delta = 0.1$?
> answer: 9 ± 1%
>
> **Why:** $(0.3/0.1)^2 = 9$.
